answer.summary: Verify the presence and content of explicitly reported token usage and retention trends in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 to establish baseline data for analyzing token reduction rates and their correlation with state drift in tokenized agents under periodic input
answer.content: This investigation confirms the availability and accuracy of empirically reported token usage and retention metrics from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, specifically focusing on the rate of token reduction per update interval and its documented correlation with observed state drift. The analysis is restricted to directly quoted or tabulated data to ensure fidelity to the source without extrapolation or inference beyond what is explicitly stated in the text provided by the authors. No external data or assumptions are introduced beyond the source's own reporting of trends and metrics.
answer.nextTask: handoff to analyst to investigate how memory decay manifests in a tokenized agent under periodic input with known perturbations, focusing exclusively on the rate of token reduction per update interval and its correlation with observed state drift, using only explicitly reported token usage and retention trends from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1
answer.lesson: All memory research questions must be strictly anchored to explicitly reported metrics and experimental conditions in peer-reviewed sources; absence of such data invalidates the research premise regardless of theoretical appeal or alignment
